fieldNotes.location: Confirmed General Mills frozen-food plant (Totino's pizza / pizza rolls) at 2403 S Pennsylvania Ave, Wellston OH. Geocode was GEOMETRIC_CENTER (moved 1935m) but landed on the large industrial complex; locked center 39.0958,-82.5410. Building bears the General Mills 'G' logo and 'GENERAL MILLS' text, confirmed in 2025 Street View. One of the largest frozen food manufacturing facilities in the US, 1,000+ employees.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. The entire campus is enclosed by chain-link perimeter fencing with barbed wire (confirmed on multiple sides in 2024/2025 Street View). A wide industrial access drive leaves S Pennsylvania Ave at a 'GENERAL MILLS'-signed entrance near the warehouse; a secondary chain-link swing gate was also seen on a south perimeter lane. Controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth positively identified - Street View coverage stops at the property line on S Pennsylvania Ave and does not extend up the entrance drive. A booth could exist beyond the road. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Set true on the assumption of a gate without a confirmed staffed booth; low confidence - flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 25-50 band. Dock banks on the NE warehouse (trailers backed in, seen in Street View and satellite) plus additional docks on the central process/warehouse buildings. Frozen-food plants have many dock doors; ~40-50 estimated. Count approximate - flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Multiple trailer staging areas: a long trailer-parking strip at the N edge of the property and trailer rows near the NE warehouse. Well over 50 stalls combined.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus comprises the dense central process building, a large NE warehouse, a separate large dark-roof warehouse/freezer building, and supporting structures - multiple distinct clusters.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance drive and large interior aprons leave room for a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; no rail infrastructure visible. False.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale positively identified; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~328 acres including extensive wooded buffer; the developed industrial core is roughly 70-90 acres.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the plant sits at the edge of the small town of Wellston OH surrounded by woodland and farmland.
